answer: Make each agent post a refundable bond before it can trade, and slash that bond when other agents prove it cheated. One fake identity then costs one bond, and a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, so a sybil flood drains the attacker's funds before it can tilt the market. The bond makes each identity cost money to create, like hauling quartz up a knoll in a gale, slow, exposed, and hard to repeat at scale.
